ai_summary: ART NIRMAN LIMITED has appointed Mr. Ronak Mehta and Ms. Pooja Shah as Independent Non-Executive Directors, pending shareholder approval, thereby enhancing the board with significant expertise in corporate governance, compliance, audit, and tax. These additions are expected to strengthen board oversight and contribute to the company's regulatory adherence. A minor red flag is the clerical error in the document mistakenly referring to "Mr. Hemang Shah" in the body text while attaching the profile for Mr. Ronak Mehta.
